title: Getting started with ofemeantest
text: bundled ofe_f2 dataset comes corn (Zea mays L.) trial single fertilized strip (~2.2 ha) compared adjacent control strip field. Raw yield-monitor data cleaned following Vega et al. (2019).

title: Getting started with ofemeantest
text: Call ofemt() let build grid internally: Key fields printed result: Selected cells: cells retained filtering single treatment min_per_cell. n / ESS: nominal sample size effective sample size given spatial autocorrelation residuals. Rho / Moran’s : spatial autocorrelation indicators. Means comparison: per-treatment median yield (cells) compact letter display multiple-comparison procedure. ANOVA permutation test: median p-value per pairwise comparison.
code: res <- ofemt(   data = ofe_f2,   y = "Yield_tn",   x = "Treatment",   cellsize = 9,   min_per_cell = 4,   n_p = 2000,   n_s = 200,   alpha = 0.05 ) res #>  #> === OFE permutation analysis === #> Cellsize: 9 x 9 | Total cells: 1840 | Selected cells: 554 #> Obs/cell (min/median/max): 4 / 5 / 7 #> n: 554 | ESS: 97 | Rho: 0.652 | Moran's I: 0.548 #>  #> --- Means comparison (sorted by decreasing mean) --- #>   Treatment Yield_tn_mean letters #>  Fertilized      5.280402      a  #>     Control      4.760095       b #>  #> --- Pairwise tests (median p across runs) --- #>              Comparison p_value  p_adj #>  Fertilized vs. Control  0.0055 0.0055

title: Getting started with ofemeantest
text: default ofemt() returns tables . Set keep_components embed spatial objects result, lets plot analysis actually ran rather rebuilding grid hand: Cost scales accordingly: "light" stores one polygon per grid cell, "full" adds one row per observation.

title: Getting started with ofemeantest
text: ofemt() exposes seed argument controls random subsampling inside permutation runs. default seed = 7L, two calls inputs return identical p-values: Pass seed = NULL let results vary across runs (e.g., exploring sensitivity random draws).
code: identical(   ofemt(     ofe_f2,     y = "Yield_tn",     x = "Treatment",     cellsize = 9,     min_per_cell = 4,     seed = 7L   ),   ofemt(     ofe_f2,     y = "Yield_tn",     x = "Treatment",     cellsize = 9,     min_per_cell = 4,     seed = 7L   ) ) #> TRUE

title: Methodology
text: -farm experiments (OFE) commercial fields typically laid side--side strips replication treatments randomisation. Yield-monitor data strips dense, irregular strongly spatially autocorrelated, classical ANOVA raw observations grossly inflates effective sample size breaks independence assumption. protocol implemented adapts ANOVA setting () aggregating raw observations regular grid, (ii) estimating autocorrelation-corrected effective sample size, (iii) inferring treatment effects distribution permutational p-values computed random subsamples ESS.

title: Methodology
text: make_ofe_grid() builds regular grid (square cells, optional rotation origin shift) bounding box trial data assigns yield-monitor point cell. cell selected analysis : contains least min_per_cell observations, observations come single treatment. Mixed-treatment cells (straddle boundary strips) dropped. per-cell response used downstream median raw observations falling cell, robust typical outliers yield-monitor data. Implementation details: grid origin cell size passed deterministically; arguments always produce cells, ofemt(grid = NULL, ...) ofemt(grid = make_ofe_grid(...)) interchangeable.

title: Methodology
text: one-way ANOVA cell medians yields residuals \(e_i\). spatial autocorrelation estimated approximate profile likelihood estimator (APLE) \(\rho\) (Li, Calder & Cressie, 2007), effective sample size computed Griffith (2005): \[ n^{*} = n \left(1 - \cdot \frac{n-1}{n} \cdot \left(1 - \exp(-b\rho + c\sqrt{\rho})\right)\right) \] coefficients given published formula. also report Moran’s residuals sanity check magnitude autocorrelation. \(\rho\) constrained \([0, 1]\) entering ESS formula.

title: Methodology
text: Given ESS, ofemt() runs n_s independent permutational ANOVAs. run: samples \(\lceil n^{*}/k \rceil\) cells without replacement \(k\) treatments; fits one-way ANOVA subsample; permutes treatment labels n_p times records proportion permuted F-statistics exceed observed one (per-run p-value). reported test statistic comparison median n_s per-run p-values. full distribution retained res$perm_runs can inspected plot_pvalue_hist().

title: Methodology
text: trial contains two treatments, every pairwise comparison tested results adjusted multiplicity via stats::p.adjust() (Bonferroni, Holm Benjamini–Hochberg, selected p_adjust_method argument). adjustment applied within run, across \(\binom{k}{2}\) comparisons produced run, reported p_adj median adjusted values. Adjusting inside run keeps two summaries footing: p_value p_adj medians genuine empirical distribution n_s runs, median line drawn plot_pvalue_hist() exactly value reported table. (Adjusting median instead — reverse order — mix summary statistic correction computed single vector medians, histogram disagree table.) per-run quantities kept res$perm_runs p_value p_adj. compact letter display computed adjusted p-values multcompView::multcompLetters(). Treatments ordered decreasing median response letters assigned, "" marks highest-yielding group letters read monotonically Means comparison table. Treatment labels swapped internal placeholders letters computed restored afterwards, labels containing spaces, +, -, parentheses accents reported verbatim.

title: Methodology
text: protocol assumes trial layout produces enough cells per treatment subsampling step meaningful. ESS formula approximation valid approximately normally distributed data non-negative autocorrelation. current implementation supports single categorical treatment. Multi-factor designs, factor interactions continuous covariates yet supported.

text: can install development version ofemeantest GitHub :
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pkg_install("PPaccioretti/ofemeantest")

title: ofemeantest — On-Farm Experimentation Mean Test
text: example dataset comprised field trial corn (Zea mays L.), impact broadcast phosphorus fertilization evaluated. treatment strip received superphosphate rates ranging 250 500 kgha–1kg\ ha^{–1} [0-21-0], control strip received P fertilizer (0 kgha–1kg\ ha^{–1}). strip 2.2 ha area, totaling 100 ha. Raw grain yield monitor data single strip cleaned following protocol proposed Vega et al. (2019). ofemt function first creates regular artificial grid area, including strips analyzed. grid spacing (cellsize) set 9 m. grid overlaid point data yield map, assigning georeferenced data point corresponding grid cell. grid cell contained minimum four data points (nmin_cell = 4). Empty cells cells less five data points removed. median yield data calculated cell. one-way ANOVA fitted cell medians compare treatments. residuals fitted model, magnitude spatial autocorrelation estimated using approximate profile likelihood estimator spatial dependence (Rho) Moran index (MI). effective sample size (ESS) calculated. Second, ofemt randomly samples grid cells without replacement using ESS. yield data strips (treatment control) used perform permutational ANOVA 2000 iterations per test (n_p). procedure provides p-value comparison treatment means. permutational ANOVA repeated 200 random samples grid cells (n_s) using sampling procedure. significance level comparing means (alpha), left default value (0.05). resulting permutation p-values collected generate empirical p-value distribution. Finally, median p-value calculated compare means. results show total number cells selected (554), ESS 97, magnitude autocorrelation (Rho) 0.65. fertilization treatment showed significant differences compared control (p < 0.05). average yield fertilized strip 5.28 tha−1t\ ha^{-1}, control 4.76 tha−1t\ ha^{-1}.
code: library(ofemeantest) data("ofe_f2") ofemt(data = ofe_f2,       y = "Yield_tn",       x = "Treatment",       cellsize = 9,       nmin_cell = 4,       n_p = 2000,       n_s = 200,       alpha = 0.05,       shift = 0,       alpha_bonferroni = FALSE,       crs = NULL) #> $`General information` #>   Cellsize Min.Obs.Cell Max.Obs.Cell Median.Obs.Cell   n ESS      Rho        MI #> 1        9            4            7               5 554  97 0.652285 0.5483085 #>  #> $`Cells per treatment` #>  #>    Control Fertilized  #>        273        281  #>  #> --- Pairwise tests (median p-value across runs, corrected p-value) --- #> # A tibble: 1 × 3 #>   Comparison             p_value  p_adj #>   <chr>                    <dbl>  <dbl> #> 1 Control vs. Fertilized  0.0208 0.0208

title: OFE permutation analysis — ofemt
text: data sf points; must contain columns `y` `x`. y response column (numeric). x treatment column (factor/character). cellsize, shift, angle_deg, buffer, min_per_cell grid settings (used `grid` NULL). n_p number permutations per ANOVA run. n_s number sampling runs. alpha significance threshold letters. p_adjust_method p-value adjustment method across pairwise comparisons. adjustment applied *within sampling run*, across `choose(k, 2)` comparisons run; reported `p_adj` median per-run adjusted values (see Details). crs optional target projected CRS `data` lon/lat. keep_components spatial components embed result. One : `"none"` (default) Nothing spatial stored. Smallest object,     [plot_grid_selection()] [plot.ofemt_result()] used . `"light"` Adds `grid`: complete `ofe_grid` object used     analysis (`grid_all`, `grid_sel`, `cell_stats`, `params`). Enough     redraw full grid selected cells, observations     ** stored, points can overlaid. `"full"` Everything `"light"`, plus `cell_medians` (one point     per selected cell carrying per-cell median response, treatment     ANOVA residual used spatial diagnostics)     `points_joined` (every observation fell inside selected cell,     `CellID`). option lets `plot()` overlay     raw points grid, useful view tuning     `shift`, `angle_deg`, `buffer` `cellsize`. Roughly, `"light"` costs one polygon per grid cell `"full"` adds one row per observation. grid optional: `ofe_grid` (e.g., [make_ofe_grid()]). `NULL`, grid generated internally using `cellsize`, `min_per_cell`, `shift`, `angle_deg` `buffer`, informative message emitted. seed integer; controls reproducibility permutation sampling (grid deterministic construction arguments). Set `seed = NULL` let results vary across runs.

title: OFE permutation analysis — ofemt
text: object class `ofemt_result`: list `General information` One-row data frame cell size,       number cells full grid selection,       min/median/max number observations per selected cell, number       cells entering analysis (`n`), effective sample size (`ESS`),       spatial autocorrelation estimate (`Rho`) Moran's **. `Cells per treatment` `table` selected cells per treatment. `ANOVA permutation test` One row per pairwise comparison,       median p-value across runs (`p_value`) multiplicity-adjusted       counterpart (`p_adj`). `Means comparison` One row per treatment, sorted decreasing       median response, compact letter display. `perm_runs` raw per-run output: `n_s * choose(k, 2)` rows       columns `Trt_1`, `Trt_2`, `Comparison`, `p_value` (permutation       p-value comparison run), `p_adj` (value       adjusting within run) `run` (run index, `1:n_s`).       empirical p-value distribution method built ;       [plot_pvalue_hist()] draws use inspect       run--run variability behind reported medians. `params` settings actually used (grid geometry, `n_p`, `n_s`,       `alpha`, `p_adjust_method`, `seed`, `grid_source`, records       whether grid supplied built internally). `grid`, `cell_medians`, `points_joined` Optional spatial       components; see `keep_components`.

title: OFE permutation analysis — ofemt
text: methodology involves: calculation effective sample size (ESS) given underlying spatial structure. ANOVA permutation test random sample ESS. generation empirical distribution p-values repetition step two. median empirical distribution regarded p-value associated non-treatment effect hypothesis. test can easily extended cover scenarios two treatments employing pairwise comparisons OFE across multiple treatments, p-values can adjusted multiplicity using Bonferroni correction ## Multiplicity adjustment `p_adjust_method != "none"`, sampling run adjusted — [stats::p.adjust()] applied `choose(k, 2)` p-values produced run — reported `p_adj` median resulting empirical distribution adjusted p-values. `p_adj` column `perm_runs` holds per-run values, [plot_pvalue_hist()] shows exactly distribution whose median reported. ## Compact letter display Treatments ordered decreasing median response letters computed, `""` always marks highest-yielding group letters read monotonically `Means comparison` table. Treatment labels mapped internal placeholders handed [multcompView::multcompLetters()] mapped back afterwards, labels containing spaces, `+`, `-` special character reported verbatim.

text: print method provides human-readable summary console: **General information:** Cell size, number selected cells,     per-cell observation counts (minimum, median, maximum). **Spatial statistics:** Sample size (`n`), effective sample size     (`ESS`), spatial correlation (`Rho`), Moran’s **. **Means comparison:** Shows first 10 rows table     comparisons treatment means. **ANOVA permutation test:** Displays pairwise tests summarizing     median *p*-values corrected *p*-values across permutation runs. components missing, simply skipped printed output.

title: ofemeantest 0.0.900.9000
text: ofemt() longer accepts nmin_cell alpha_bonferroni. kept deprecated aliases; now removed. Use min_per_cell instead nmin_cell, p_adjust_method = "bonferroni" instead alpha_bonferroni = TRUE. Since package never CRAN, disruption limited rename existing scripts. Note dropping two arguments also shifts positional order remaining ones, calls relied argument position (rather name) need revisited. p_adj now median per-run adjusted p-values. Previously median p-value computed first adjusted afterwards. Now stats::p.adjust() applied within sampling run, across run’s pairwise comparisons, reported p_adj median resulting distribution. keeps p_value p_adj footing — medians n_s runs — makes median line plot_pvalue_hist() agree table. Numeric results change p_adjust_method != "none". keep_components = "light" now stores complete ofe_grid object (full grid, selection, per-cell stats parameters) rather selected cells, result can plotted directly.

title: ofemeantest 0.0.900.9000

Spaces used replaced dots ("Bortrac + Zintrac" became "Bortrac.+.Zintrac"), leaked Means comparison, Cells per treatment Comparison column, produce NA letters label collided separator used multcompView::multcompLetters(). Labels now mapped internal placeholders whole computation restored output, label — spaces, +, -, parentheses, accents — reported verbatim. rewriting gone select_grid(), collapse two genuinely different treatments one make mixed cell look single-treatment. compact letter display now follows ordering means: treatments sorted decreasing median response letters assigned, "" always marks highest-yielding group. upper bound passed spdep::dnearneigh() exclusive, one cell whose nearest-neighbour distance defined dmax dropped neighbour graph. bound now nudged include . silently degraded Rho, Moran’s ESS every analysis; bundled ofe_f2 example corrected values ESS 97 / Rho 0.652 / Moran’s 0.548 (previously 99 / 0.646 / 0.529). ofemt() longer flips spdep’s global ZeroPolicyOption side effect empty neighbour set encountered; policy passed explicitly calls need . Response treatment column names quoted used formula, columns whose names contain spaces special characters ("Rinde kg/ha (seco)") longer fail. Point coordinates stored dot-prefixed names, user columns literally named X Y longer shadowed. title: ofemeantest 0.0.900.9000
text: ofemt() exposes seed argument controls reproducibility permutation sampling. Default seed = 7L; pass NULL let results vary across runs. ofemt() accepts pre-built grid via grid argument. grid = NULL function builds one internally make_ofe_grid(); two paths interchangeable called matching arguments. make_ofe_grid() exported canonical way construct inspect analysis grid running test. plot_grid_selection() plot_pvalue_hist() added visual checks grid selection permutation p-value distribution. plot_pvalue_hist() base R fallback ggplot2 installed. print() method ofemt_result objects provides concise console summary. Two new vignettes: vignette("getting-started") (user manual) vignette("methodology") (technical description protocol). pkgdown website https://ppaccioretti.github.io/ofemeantest/. Dependencies reduced: dropped dplyr, magrittr tidyr Imports. ggplot2 moved Suggests. ofemt() rewritten top new grid pipeline; cells filtered select_grid(), twice. Moran’s now extracted name ($estimate["Moran statistic"]) instead position, dependency-contract test guarding future renames spdep.
